passages.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied: “How long until you end these speeches? Show some sense, and then we can talk.
passages.sermon:
Bildad was a Shuhite.
He replied.
He said, "How long will you keep speaking?"
"How long will you keep using so many words?"
"Show understanding."
"Then we will speak."
passages.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ עַד־ אָ֤נָה׀ תְּשִׂימ֣וּן קִנְצֵ֣י לְמִלִּ֑ין תָּ֝בִ֗ינוּ וְאַחַ֥ר נְדַבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: Why are we regarded as cattle, as stupid in your sight?
passages.sermon:
Bildad the Shuhite spoke.
He asked a question.
He said, "Why do you see us as animals?"
He said, "Why do you think we are foolish?"
He said, "Why do you consider us stupid in your eyes?"
passages.original: מַ֭דּוּעַ נֶחְשַׁ֣בְנוּ כַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נִ֝טְמִ֗ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You who tear yourself in anger— should the earth be forsaken on your account, or the rocks be moved from their place?
passages.sermon:
Bildad the Shuhite spoke to Job.
Bildad saw that Job was angry and upset.
Bildad said, “You are tearing yourself apart in your anger.”
He asked Job, “Should the whole earth be abandoned because of you?”
He also asked, “Should the rocks be moved from their place for your sake?”
passages.original: טֹֽרֵ֥ף נַפְשׁ֗וֹ בְּאַ֫פּ֥וֹ הַ֭לְמַעַנְךָ תֵּעָ֣זַב אָ֑רֶץ וְיֶעְתַּק־ צ֝֗וּר מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Indeed, the lamp of the wicked is extinguished; the flame of his fire does not glow.
passages.sermon:
The wicked person lives in darkness.
His lamp goes out.
His fire does not shine.
No light comes from him.
God removes his brightness.
The wicked lose their hope.
passages.original: גַּ֤ם א֣וֹר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־ יִ֝גַּ֗הּ שְׁבִ֣יב אִשּֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: The light in his tent grows dark, and the lamp beside him goes out.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the wicked person.
\r\nThe wicked person lives in a tent.
\r\nThe light inside his tent becomes dark.
\r\nThe lamp near him goes out.
passages.original: א֭וֹר חָשַׁ֣ךְ בְּאָהֳל֑וֹ וְ֝נֵר֗וֹ עָלָ֥יו יִדְעָֽךְ׃

passages.text: His vigorous stride is shortened, and his own schemes trip him up.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man walks with strong steps.
His steps become weak and short.
His own plans cause him to fall.
His own advice brings him down.
passages.original: יֵֽ֭צְרוּ צַעֲדֵ֣י אוֹנ֑וֹ וְֽתַשְׁלִיכֵ֥הוּ עֲצָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For his own feet lead him into a net, and he wanders into its mesh.
passages.sermon:
A wicked man walks into a net.
His own feet lead him there.
He wanders into a mesh.
He becomes trapped by what he steps into.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ שֻׁלַּ֣ח בְּרֶ֣שֶׁת בְּרַגְלָ֑יו וְעַל־ שְׂ֝בָכָ֗ה יִתְהַלָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: A trap seizes his heel; a snare grips him.
passages.sermon: A trap catches his heel.\r\nA snare holds him tightly.
passages.original: יֹאחֵ֣ז בְּעָקֵ֣ב פָּ֑ח יַחֲזֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו צַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: A noose is hidden in the ground, and a trap lies in his path.
passages.sermon: A noose is hidden in the ground.\r\nA trap lies in his path.
passages.original: טָמ֣וּן בָּאָ֣רֶץ חַבְל֑וֹ וּ֝מַלְכֻּדְתּ֗וֹ עֲלֵ֣י נָתִֽיב׃

passages.text: Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step.
passages.sermon: Terrors surround him on every side.\r\nTerrors frighten him.\r\nTerrors harass his every step.
passages.original: סָ֭בִיב בִּֽעֲתֻ֣הוּ בַלָּה֑וֹת וֶהֱפִיצֻ֥הוּ לְרַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: His strength is depleted, and calamity is ready at his side.
passages.sermon:
The wicked man loses his strength.
He becomes weak.
Disaster stands ready beside him.
Calamity waits at his side.
passages.original: יְהִי־ רָעֵ֥ב אֹנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֵ֗יד נָכ֥וֹן לְצַלְעֽוֹ׃

passages.text: It devours patches of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs.
passages.sermon:
The man suffers under God’s judgment.
Something devours patches of his skin.
The firstborn of death devours his limbs.
His body is attacked and destroyed.
passages.original: יֹ֭אכַל בַּדֵּ֣י עוֹר֑וֹ יֹאכַ֥ל בַּ֝דָּ֗יו בְּכ֣וֹר מָֽוֶת׃

passages.text: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
passages.sermon:
This man loses his home.
He loses his place of safety.
Someone forces him out.
They take him away.
They bring him to the king of terrors.
passages.original: יִנָּתֵ֣ק מֵ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְ֝תַצְעִדֵ֗הוּ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּלָּהֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling.
passages.sermon:
Fire lives in his tent.
He has no one left there.
Burning sulfur falls on his home.
Sulfur destroys his dwelling.
passages.original: תִּשְׁכּ֣וֹן בְּ֭אָהֳלוֹ מִבְּלִי־ ל֑וֹ יְזֹרֶ֖ה עַל־ נָוֵ֣הוּ גָפְרִֽית׃

passages.text: The roots beneath him dry up, and the branches above him wither away.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes a wicked man who faces God's judgment.
The roots under him dry up.
The branches above him wither.
passages.original: מִ֭תַּחַת שָֽׁרָשָׁ֣יו יִבָ֑שׁוּ וּ֝מִמַּ֗עַל יִמַּ֥ל קְצִירֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The memory of him perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the land.
passages.sermon: This man is wicked.\r\nPeople forget him on earth.\r\nNo one remembers his name in the land.
passages.original: זִֽכְרוֹ־ אָ֭בַד מִנִּי־ אָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־ שֵׁ֥ם ל֝֗וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ חֽוּץ׃

passages.text: He is driven from light into darkness and is chased from the inhabited world.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the fate of a wicked person who does not know God.
God drives this person away from light.
God sends this person into darkness.
People chase this person away from the world where people live.
This person no longer belongs among the living.
passages.original: יֶ֭הְדְּפֻהוּ מֵא֣וֹר אֶל־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּֽמִתֵּבֵ֥ל יְנִדֻּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: He has no offspring or posterity among his people, no survivor where he once lived.
passages.sermon:
This man is wicked.
He has no children among his people.
He has no grandchildren among his people.
No one survives from his family where he once lived.
passages.original: לֹ֘א נִ֤ין ל֣וֹ וְלֹא־ נֶ֣כֶד בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין שָׂ֝רִ֗יד בִּמְגוּרָֽיו׃

passages.text: Those in the west are appalled at his fate, while those in the east tremble in horror.
passages.sermon:
This man faces a terrible fate.
People in the west see what happens to him.
They are shocked and appalled.
People in the east hear about his fate.
They tremble in fear and horror.
passages.original: עַל־ י֭וֹמוֹ נָשַׁ֣מּוּ אַחֲרֹנִ֑ים וְ֝קַדְמֹנִ֗ים אָ֣חֲזוּ שָֽׂעַר׃

passages.text: Surely such is the dwelling of the wicked and the place of one who does not know God.”
passages.sermon:
The wicked live in these places.
This is the home of people who do evil.
This is where those who do not know God stay.
God is not known in this place.
These are the homes of the wicked.
These are the places for those who do not know God.
passages.original: אַךְ־ אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁכְּנ֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וְ֝זֶ֗ה מְק֣וֹם לֹא־ יָדַֽע־ אֵֽל׃ס
